name: Jerry's Electric
old_description: Founded in 1976, Jerry’s Electric established itself as a premier partner in the utility and industrial electrical sectors. We are a proud, family-owned American business located just outside Colman, SD. Our extensive facility enables us to ship products throughout the United States and into Canada. We focus on delivering affordable, efficient, and straightforward solutions for the sale, repair, and recycling of oil-filled electrical equipment. Our mission is to offer high-quality transformers, regulators, switchgear and repair services, ensuring exceptional speed and support. Ultimately, we aim to positively impact the lives of our customers and employees through our dedicated actions and core
about:
Jerry's Electric was founded in 1976 as a family-owned business serving the utility and industrial electrical sectors. The company operates from a facility just outside Colman, South Dakota, and ships its products and services throughout the United States and into Canada.

The company remanufactures transformers, voltage regulators, and switchgear, and provides repair, testing, and diagnostic services for oil-filled electrical equipment. Its remanufacturing process uses new insulating oil, new copper windings, and Kraft diamond-back paper insulation. Transformer offerings range from single-phase pole-mount units (5–500 kVA) to three-phase substation and pad-mount units up to 10 MVA. The facility also performs PCB analysis of insulating oil using gas chromatography and carries out full transformer reclamation, including safe decommissioning, oil and component recycling, and detailed reporting.

Jerry's Electric serves utility and industrial customers across North America. Its client base includes electric utilities, industrial plants, and other operators of oil-filled transformer equipment who require remanufactured units, repair services, or environmental compliance testing.

The company emphasizes fast, affordable solutions without sacrificing quality, backing remanufactured transformers with a three-year warranty. Its differentiation rests on using new rather than filtered oil, new copper conductors, and a reclamation process designed to minimize environmental impact while maximizing material recovery.

name: Jersey Metalworks, LLC
old_description: Jersey Metal Works has been crafting sheet metal products since 1992. Our fabrication services include bending and forming, welding, rolling and finishing. Jersey Metal Works will hold your specified tolerances and will fabricate to your dimensions. We are capable of working with a variety of materials up to and including 10 gauge aluminum, steel, stainless steel and other materials including some plastics.
about:
Jersey Metalworks, LLC, based in Somerset, New Jersey, traces its roots to 1992 when it began crafting steel parts and miscellaneous iron pieces for the construction industry. The company later merged in 2008 with a local full-service machine shop, combining capabilities to serve a broader client base.

The shop provides metal fabrication and machining services including bending, forming, welding, rolling, finishing, anodizing for aluminum railings, and custom painting. It works with materials up to 10-gauge aluminum, steel, stainless steel, and some plastics, producing custom one-off parts, replacement components for older machinery, prototype pieces, and repetitive production runs.

Customers span manufacturing, processing, construction, and medical-facility sectors, primarily across New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania, with shipping throughout the United States, Canada, and internationally.

The company emphasizes precision production, timely delivery, and competitive pricing, building a reputation for holding customer-specified tolerances and solving diverse metal design and fabrication needs.

name: Jet Plastics
old_description: Founded in 1948, Jet Plastics is one of the pioneers in the plastics industry.  Emerging from the need for plastics in the developing aerospace industry after the Second World War, we have established a tradition of innovation and service.  As we eagerly move forward, we are confident and determined to maintain our traditions and continue to build on our rich history.
about:
Jet Plastics was founded in 1948 in Los Angeles, California, emerging from the demand for plastic components in the post‑World War II aerospace sector. The company began as a pioneer in the plastics industry, establishing a tradition of innovation and service that has continued for over seven decades.

The company specializes in custom plastic profile extrusion, injection molding, and fabrication, supported by in‑house tool making and secondary operations. These capabilities allow Jet Plastics to produce a wide range of plastic parts and profiles from raw material through finished components at its Los Angeles facility.

While its roots lie in aerospace, Jet Plastics serves a broad base of industrial customers requiring custom plastic extrusions and molded parts. The company also operates an online store offering stock products for direct purchase.

Jet Plastics emphasizes its deep experience, noting that there is "very little we have not seen" in the plastics industry, and aims to maintain its traditions of innovation and service as it moves forward.

name: Jet Speed Metals
old_description: Jet Speed Metals is your trusted partner for high-quality metal distribution and fabrication. We specialize in fast-turnaround solutions for small to mid-sized businesses, job sites, and one-time orders. Whether you need stocked materials off the shelf, precision cutting from your CAD files and drawings, or custom fabrication, we deliver with speed and accuracy.
about:
Jet Speed Metals operates from Westbrook, Maine. The company was founded to address a gap in fast-turnaround metal fabrication and distribution for small to mid-sized businesses, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released.

The shop provides custom steel fabrication and rapid material distribution. Core processes include CNC plasma cutting of steel, aluminum, and other metals up to 1.25 inches thick; saw cutting with bevel and miter capabilities for tubes, pipes, angles, and flat bars; shearing of sheet metal up to 0.5 inches thick and 10 feet wide; oxy-fuel cutting for materials up to 6 inches thick; and ironworker services such as punching, notching, and shearing of angle iron and flat bar. The company also stocks plates, sheets, angles, and tubing for immediate pickup or delivery.

Jet Speed Metals serves small to mid-sized businesses, job sites, and one-time orders. Customers range from local fabricators and contractors to manufacturers needing quick-turn custom parts or stock material.

The company emphasizes speed, precision, and reliability, offering same-day service on stocked items and the ability to cut from customer CAD files and drawings. It was created to fill a market gap for responsive, small-order metal solutions.

name: Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts
old_description: At Jim Coleman Automotive, we only stock parts and accessories that meet the highest standards of quality and compatibility for your vehicle. From routine maintenance to more specific repairs, we have the parts you need. And if we don’t have it, we’ll order it for you and get it to you as quickly as possible!
about:
Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts operates from Bethesda, Maryland, as the parts division of Jim Coleman Automotive, a dealership group the Coleman family founded in 1952. The business began as a single dealership and has grown to serve the Greater Washington, D.C. area from locations in Bethesda, Silver Spring, Clarksville, and Ellicott City, remaining family-owned throughout its history.

The division distributes OEM parts and accessories for multiple vehicle brands to both retail customers and professional shops. It runs a dedicated wholesale program that integrates with OPSTrax, PartsTrader, CollisionLink, and CCCIS ordering platforms, allowing body shops and repair facilities to place orders online, by phone, email, or fax. The company stocks a range of maintenance items — wiper blades, floor mats, cargo nets, and cargo mats — and carries OEM tires from Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear, Dunlop, and other major brands. Delivery is offered same-day or next-day within the region, and a 30-day return window applies to most parts.

Primary customers include collision centers, mechanical repair shops, and fleet operators throughout the D.C., Maryland, and Virginia corridor, as well as walk-in retail buyers. The wholesale program is structured specifically for body shops, with free access to the major estimating and ordering systems used in the collision-repair workflow.

The company emphasizes its legacy of community roots and service-first approach, positioning the wholesale parts operation as an extension of the dealership group's long-standing commitment to the region rather than a standalone parts house.

name: Johnson Metal Works
old_description: Whether you’re creating a production run of components, an architectural element for a construction project, or need help bringing a napkin sketch to life, Johnson Metal Works has your back. With our experts in metal fabrication and design, you are limited only by your imagination, and sometimes not even that!
about:
Johnson Metal Works, operating as JMW, is a metal fabrication shop based in Bozeman, Montana. The company provides custom metal fabrication services including sheet and tube laser cutting, forming, finishing, and field dimensioning.

The shop specializes in custom-fabricated metal components using steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, with CNC equipment capable of cutting aluminum up to 3/8 inch thick. Core processes include design engineering for manufacturability, structural and industrial fabrication, architectural metalwork, and welded assemblies. A rotary-index tube laser enables precision cutting of complex profiles with repeatability that reduces fabrication time. The facility produces frames, supports, railings, canopies, trusses, and complex profiles for OEM parts and repeatable production runs.

Johnson Metal Works serves OEM, architectural, structural, construction, and industrial markets. Its components appear in architectural facades, interior partitions, shade structures, HVAC and mechanical support systems, commercial and residential furniture, lighting installations, stair components, and transport and industrial trailers. The company also fabricates metal casings and protective cages for machinery.

The company's stated mission is to “Empower” customers through design engineering that optimizes parts for cost-effectiveness and quality. Differentiators include the rotary-index tube laser for complex tube profiles, CNC cutting of thick aluminum, and field dimensioning services to ensure fit-up on site.

old_description: Empower your business by entrusting us with the production of your steel parts. Our advanced facilities and skilled team guarantee top-quality components, while our streamlined processes enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
about:
Joining Metals, a family-owned and operated small business in Perry, Ohio, was established in 2002 to provide sheet metal fabrication and assembly services. Known locally as the Laser Cutting Company, it has built a reputation for manufacturing precision parts that meet exact client specifications.

The company operates a 30,000-square-foot facility producing over one million parts annually with a 99.9% on-time delivery rate. It offers metal parts manufacturing from low-volume prototyping to high-volume production, specializing in laser cutting and precision sheet metal fabrication and assembly, supported by a diverse, experienced team.

Its customer base spans logistics, material handling, conveyor systems, industrial filtration, cylinder manufacturing, hospitality and retail, personal and medical mobility, and aftermarket automotive performance parts.

The company emphasizes its commitment to quality, on-time delivery, and continuous improvement, positioning itself as a laser cutting specialist that meets exact specifications while fostering long-term partnerships through values of safety, integrity, teamwork, quality, and service. Its mission focuses on sustainable growth, ensuring resource efficiency from prototype to production.

about:
Joly's Metal Works, Inc. was founded by Lucien Joly on July 9, 1979, in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company has since tripled in size and expanded its workload to serve all of Louisiana and the coastal Gulf Coast region.

The shop operates as a general metal fabrication and installation contractor, specializing in carbon steel, galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and brass. Its 26,500-to-28,500-square-foot facility employs 35 tradesmen and houses equipment including computerized cutting systems, press brakes, rollers, shears, iron workers, an automated band saw, and an 8-by-22-foot automated cutting table. The facility processes material from 26-gauge sheet metal up to 2-inch-thick plate. The company also provides estimation, detailing, on-site measurement, and design services, working from customer drawings, CAD files, or hand sketches.

Joly's Metal Works serves customers across Louisiana and the Gulf Coast, though specific industry sectors are not detailed in its public materials. The company is licensed and insured and maintains a fleet of service vehicles for on-site installation.

The firm emphasizes staying current with technology to deliver quality work, and its estimators aim to provide accurate, fair pricing in a timely manner.

name: Jones Plastic & Engineering
old_description: Founded in 1961, Jones Plastic & Engineering has spent decades building one of North America’s most integrated plastic manufacturing operations. From pioneering gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s to operating a dedicated robotic paint and hydrographics facility in Juarez, Mexico, Jones Plastic combines deep process knowledge with broad manufacturing capability.
about:
Jones Plastic & Engineering was founded in 1961 in Louisville, Kentucky, by Harry and Larry Jones as a single-machine operation producing whiskey bottle caps. The family-owned business, now headed by the second and third generations of the Jones family, is based in Jeffersontown, Kentucky, and operates nine facilities across the United States and Mexico.

The company provides integrated plastic manufacturing services, including product development, tooling, injection molding (65 to 3,150 tons across five facilities), robotic paint, hydrographics, assembly, and testing. A dedicated 90,000-square-foot paint and hydrographics plant in Juárez, Mexico, houses a 25,000-square-foot clean-room paint line with FANUC robots, RFID-controlled rack systems, and a 1.3-meter hydrographic dip tank. An in-house 3D printing lab runs FDM and PolyJet systems for functional prototypes and short-run injection molded samples. Total manufacturing space approaches 1.6 million square feet with roughly 3,000 employees.

Jones Plastic serves automotive, appliance, powersports, outdoor products, consumer goods, and industrial and defense markets, supplying components and assemblies to North American OEMs. The company also operates Rev-A-Shelf, a wholly owned subsidiary that manufactures residential cabinet storage and organizational products.

The firm pioneered gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s and emphasizes an engineering-first approach, using solid modeling, CAE simulation, and rapid prototyping to validate designs before tooling. Integrating molding, finishing, and assembly under one supply chain aims to reduce freight, handling, and coordination costs. Quality management is ISO 9001 certified.
